fee_notes: Standard single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $49,500. A 25% VetFran discount reduces the fee to $37,125 for qualifying honorably discharged veterans. Conversion Franchises may receive up to a 25% reduction ($37,125 to $49,500 range). During fiscal year 2025, the range of Initial Franchise Fees collected was $37,125 to $49,500. No Conversion Initial Franchise Fees were collected in fiscal year 2025. Existing franchisees opening a new Franchised Business also pay a Technology and Training Setup Fee of $1,000 or $2,500 depending on entity structure and Operating Principal training status.
raw_excerpt:
The standard initial franchise fee for one Franchised Business is $49,500 ("Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is paid at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement and is deemed fully earned and non-refundable upon payment.

During fiscal year 2025, the range of Initial Franchise Fees collected was between $37,125 (from a VetFran Program discount) and $49,500.

If you qualify for a Conversion Franchise, we may, but are not obligated, to reduce the Initial Franchise Fee up to 25%... you will pay the Conversion Initial Franchise Fee of $37,125 up to $49,500 at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement.

We offer a 25% discount on the Initial Franchise Fee for Franchised Businesses acquired by individuals who qualify under the VetFran program.
